article.title: Stensul開放電郵成效回饋功能搶先體驗，審批仍由人員負責
article.title_en: Stensul opens early access to email performance feedback with human approval
article.summary: Stensul稱新功能把電郵表現連到內容版本，供團隊參考。Salesforce Marketing Cloud Next整合則已正式開放。
article.summary_en: Stensul says the new feature links email performance to content variants. Its Salesforce Marketing Cloud Next integration is generally available.
highlights: 電郵成效回饋屬搶先體驗。
行銷人員保留檢查、審批及決定發送內容的權限。
highlights_en: Email performance feedback is in early access.
Marketers retain review, approval and control over what is sent.
article.why: 電郵團隊可用內容層級資料找出值得再測的主旨、預覽文字或地區版本。
article.why_en: Content-level data can help email teams choose subject lines, preview text or local variants to test again.
article.next_step: 先選一項內容變數，設定對照組及成功指標，再比較下一次發送結果。
article.next_step_en: Pick one variable, set a control and agree on a success metric before the next send.
article.detail: Stensul把既有的內容審批流程延伸到發送後的表現分析。公司稱團隊可利用個人化或地區版本的表現找出值得研究的內容模式，再決定是否在下一封採用。不同受眾、促銷和發送時間都可能影響數字，因此觀察到的關聯需要再測試。這次正式開放的是Salesforce整合，電郵回饋功能仍處於搶先體驗。
article.detail_en: Stensul extends its approval workflow into post-send analysis. It says teams can use personalised or localised variants to identify patterns worth testing. Audience, offers and timing can all affect results, so observed associations need testing. General availability applies to the Salesforce integration; the feedback feature remains in early access.
